description: {{DESCRIPTION}} Signals are computed from official public data (FRED, BLS, BEA, SEC EDGAR, openFDA, World Bank) collected on a schedule; every answer carries a 0-100 composite score, trend, risk flags, a confidence level, rationale text and citation links back to the source. POST /v1/signals for a ranked list, /v1/signal {series_id} for one, /v1/explain for why it moved, /v1/events and /v1/catalog. Every response is a single JSON object. Research signal, not investment advice.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/signals, /v1/signal, /v1/explain, /v1/events, /v1/catalog; GET /v1/version, /v1/health. JSON body only. Bad input returns 400 + JSON.

serving.backend: Node.js HTTP server (zero npm dependencies) behind a RelayMiner at http://<container>:8080. No caller auth. Answers come from a private hub that is refreshed by a scheduled collector; 5-minute cache.
serving.notes: Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
